# Dashboard Model

## Purpose
The Dashboard Model defines the structure for user-customizable dashboards, including layouts, cells, and data mapping for visualizations.

## Key Entities
- **DashboardPreset**: A saved dashboard configuration.
- **GridLayout**: Defines the arrangement of cells in a grid.
- **GridLayoutCell**: A specific cell within a grid layout.
- **CellContent**: The content or widget within a cell.
- **DataMapper**: Maps data sources to visual components.

## Class Diagram
```mermaid
classDiagram
    Baseclass <|-- DashboardPreset
    Baseclass <|-- GridLayout
    Baseclass <|-- GridLayoutCell
    Baseclass <|-- CellContent
    Baseclass <|-- CellContentElement
    Baseclass <|-- CellToLayout
    Baseclass <|-- DataMapper
    Baseclass <|-- GraphTemplate

    DashboardPreset "1" -- "1" GridLayout
    GridLayout "1" *-- "many" GridLayoutCell
    GridLayoutCell "1" -- "1" CellContent
    CellContent "1" *-- "many" CellContentElement
    CellContent "1" -- "many" DataMapper
    CellContent "1" -- "1" GraphTemplate

    class DashboardPreset {
        +String name
        +GridLayout gridLayout
    }
    class GridLayout {
        +int columns
        +int rows
    }
    class GridLayoutCell {
        +int x
        +int y
        +int width
        +int height
    }
    class CellContent {
        +String title
    }
```
